Yes, I have asked for their permissions.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lLXVYEB.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/IN3iyHn.png[/img]
[/b]A user by the name of  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/42958370]nanamireina7[/url] has also made their own 1.6 patch, and it is available on their [url=https://discord.com/invite/G8nxxW8T7F]discord[/url]!
(I still have these pictures. Imgur just deleted them....)

I've made a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27668]portrait mod[/url] to go with the unique portrait codes. NinTheCactus' original mod has been taken down while they update it.
Check the changelog for update notes! If there are any bugs, please let me know and  I'll try to fix them to the best of my ability.

TO INSTALL!! :
[b]  Be sure you have SMAPI installed to run mods. [/b]All mods should be located in "steam/steamapps/common/stardew valley/mods."

1: Have [b]Content Patcher, Mail Custom Framework, [/b]and[b] Event Repeater [/b]installed, and have their folders inside the mod folder.
2: Unzip the mod folder.
3. Put both folders[b] [/b]in the mod folder.
﻿If attempting to change configuration, open the "config.json" file in the folder to enable/disable certain events, if you do not use Generic Mod Config.

[b][u][size=3]CONFIGURATION
[/size][/u][/b]
﻿[b]ChangeSchedule [/b]enables [b]Stalker[/b] Elliott[b].[/b] [b]CertainEvents[/b] will enable [b]Black [/b]events.[color=#e69138] [/color][b]DivorceEvents [/b][color=#e69138][b]enable divorce events.[/b] [/color][color=#e69138][b]These events contain themes of suicide. [/b][/color]
------------------------------------------------

[size=3][b][u]!! WARNING !! :[/u][color=#e69138] This mod includes topics of emotional and mental manipulation[/color][u]/[/u][color=#e69138]abuse, suicidal threats and implications, codependency and control, stalking, and more.[/color]
[color=#e69138]Download at your own risk. Your mental health matters more then an optional mod.[/color][/b][/size]
[size=2]
[b][u]For those who don't know, the Yandere Elliott Expansion mod includes...[/u][/b]

[b]Unique dialogue![/b]
﻿- This includes pre and post-marriage dialogue, and divorce. Also comes with Festival dialogue and reactions by the townspeople.

Two "routes," [b]white and black[/b], depending on the player's actions during the unique events. [b]Black [/b]events are automatically turned on.
[b]Stalker Elliott[/b] schedule is automatically turned[b] on[/b], the divorce events are automatically turned [b]off.[/b] You will need to go into the mod manager to enable or disable them.

[b]Letters!
[/b]Elliott will send a letter to the farmer after every [b]festival, heart event [[/b]modded and base game], [b]and the start of every month. [/b]He will also send a letter if the farmer is dating a[b] bachelor [/b]that is not him, or if they are dating [b]every bachelor except him. [/b]
Elliott will no longer send letters after a certain amount of hearts is reached, and when you marry him. 

------------------------------------------------

[/size][b][u][size=3]UNIQUE EVENTS AND THEIR TRIGGERS.[/size][/u]
[/b]
[u]Base Expansion Events.[/u]
[b]1-HEART EVENT[/b]
10PM at the Mountain.

[b]3-HEART EVENT
[/b]Post-Summer 28 Festival, at the beach.

[b]5-HEART EVENT.
[/b]12PM-5PM at Elliott's Cabin.

[b]7-HEART EVENT.
MUST BE BEFORE BASE 10 HEART EVENT.[/b] Leave Farmhouse during a sunny day.

[b]9-HEART EVENT.
[/b]Post 5-Heart event, 8PM, entering the Farmhouse while raining.

[u][size=3]ROUTE EVENTS.
[/size]"Black" Events:

[/u][b]EVENT 1: [/b]Date all bachelors, but do not view basegame event. Have 11 hearts with Elliott and enter the bar.

[b]EVENT 2: [/b]Have 13 hearts with Elliott; enter the farm.

[b]EVENT 3: [/b]Have 14 hearts with Elliott; enter the farmhouse after 8PM.

[b][u]"White Events:"

[/u]EVENT 1: [/b]If [b]BLACK EVENT 1 [/b]has not been triggered, reach 13 hearts with Elliott and read the letter.

[b]EVENT 2: [/b]After 7PM, go to the beach.

[b][u][size=3]DIVORCE EVENTS.[/size]

[/u]EVENT 1: [/b]Leave the farmhouse the next day after divorcing Elliott.

[b]EVENT 2:[/b] Read the letter sent by Elliott. Then go to the beach.
